parameters.content:
## F&F chat action engine
Called only by the Ops Assistant. Never run on its own.

**propose**: reads live data, checks the user's F&F role and business rules, saves a proposal + one-time code to `audit_logs`. Writes nothing.

**execute** (only after the human types `confirm CODE`): re-plans against fresh data, re-checks permission, applies **one guarded write**, records the result in `audit_logs`. F&F database triggers still enforce stage gates.
